answer: Each identity locks 70 credits to enter a terrace tournament. Every round the beacon sends a challenge; rivals answer in ten minutes or lose. Replies must carry a cedar key-seal, so a rented stand-in cannot play for another; a mismatch burns the bond. Entry costs 40 for the first, 40+6(k-1) for the k-th: 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 prize pool. Honest agents pay 40 once. The timber tally lists each match for replay.
